question: Who among the following is a renowned Tabla player carrying on the legacy of his father?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Zakir Hussain__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Zakir Hussain Alla Rakha Qureshi was born on **March 9, 1951,** in Bombay, India.
 
• He is the son of** Ustad Allah Rakha Khan**, a well-known Indian tabla player. 
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Shree **by the Government of India in the** year 1988**, thus making him the youngest percussionist ever to receive this award. 
 
• In 2002, Zakir Hussain once again became the youngest percussionist to be honored with India’s third-highest civilian award.
 
• He was also awarded the** Grammy for the album ‘Planet Drum’ **which was produced and created by Zakir Hussain and Mickey Hart.
 
• In 2006, the government of Madhya Pradesh honored him with this prestigious award, which is given to artists with exceptional achievements in their respective fields.​
